name: Groundhog Inc.
summary: Established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 2001, Groundhog Inc. is a leading provider of mobility intelligence solutions within the Taiwanese market. Its core activities include developing information software, offering data processing services, and supplying electronic information. Additionally, the company engages in the wholesale and retail of information software, electronic materials, and telecommunication equipment. Among its specialized platforms is CovMo, a system designed for network optimization and geographic positioning. It helps identify and resolve various mobile network challenges, including improving signal strength, managing VIP customer service, and facilitating small cell deployments. Another key offering is RealMotion, an application used for analyzing the movement patterns of individuals infected with viruses and their contacts, supporting effective contact tracing efforts. Furthermore, Groundhog Inc. presents MI-DMP, a mobile smart data analysis platform enabling telecommunication operators to broaden their service offerings and effectively monetize their data. Finally, there's MI-DSP, a mobile smart real-time bidding platform designed to facilitate real-time bidding advertising services, emphasizing user data privacy and security.
